items.title: Why testing is essential for reliable applications

source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic Why testing is essential for reliable applications as printed (PDF 64, printed 60); its own lesson since 2026-10-29 (one lesson per book heading), moved from the topic 5.2.1 lesson.

blocks.text: Testing checks whether an application meets its requirements. It ensures that all functions produce correct results. Testing reduces the risk of crashes or incorrect outputs. It also helps verify that changes do not break existing features. Applications that are thoroughly tested are more trustworthy and stable.
